name: Crypto stress
summary: Bitcoin near $63,300 on 19 Nov, 27% below its 52-week high and 19% lower over a month
state: Bitcoin was near $63,273 at 05:40 UTC on 19 Nov, 26.9% below its 52-week high of $86,603, 1.3% lower on the week and 18.7% lower over a month (Yahoo Finance). Its worst day of the past five fell 2.5%. The drawdown is past the 25% Watch line; no major stablecoin de-peg or top-10 exchange failure was found in this run's searches.
for_you: Crypto prices are in a deep drawdown. Holders face large swings; crypto assets are not covered by UK deposit protection.

rubric.alert: Drawdown > 45%, or a major stablecoin de-pegs (> 3% for > 24h), or a top-10 exchange fails.

rubric.normal: Bitcoin drawdown from 52-week high < 25% and no major stablecoin/exchange incidents.
